images.title: Compass arc from D
images.purpose: Show that the compass point goes at D, the end of the base, so the 7 cm arc cuts the perpendicular at B.
images.composition: One construction figure centred with wide white space.
images.exact_structure: Base DC of 5 cm horizontal at the bottom with D on the left and C on the right. A vertical line l at C, with a small square mark at C. A grey #6B7280 arc with centre D and radius 7 cm cutting l at B, about 4.9 cm above C. Segment DB drawn teal #0072B2 labelled 7 cm. The point D marked with a small amber #E69F00 dot as the compass point. Exactly 1 base, 1 line l, 1 arc, 1 diagonal.

images.takeaway: Put the compass point at D, not at C.
images.description: Base DC of 5 cm, a perpendicular at C, and a 7 cm arc centred at D cutting it at B, with DB shown in teal.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at where the compass point sits and where the arc meets the line.
